notes.title: Atomic Wilds is coming May 31st!
notes.content: Atomic Wilds is releasing May 31st at 1pm est! It's been a long, trying journey to bring this game to everyone (approx. 3 and a half years), but it will soon be in your hands to play! Unfortunately I was unable to provide a way to bring your demo save over to the main game, but some things are a bit different from the demo so I hope everyone will be good with giving it a fresh start. I look forward to hearing from everyone after you've had the chance to play the full game in two weeks. If you really enjoy the game please try to leave a review, and if you have criticisms or issues with bugs I will do my best to address your concerns in a timely manner. See you all in two weeks!
